title: I2-DMSO mediated multi-component cascade cyclization to construct pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyrrolo[3,4-d]pyridine-6-one skeleton
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28280-28284
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04871K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yu-Man Song, Li-Sheng Wang, You Zhou, Yong-Xing Tang, Chun-Yan Wu, Yan-Dong Wu, An-Xin Wu
A one-pot synthesis of the pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyrrolo[3,4-d]pyridin-6-one skeleton has been developed using aryl methyl ketones, 3-aminopyrazoles, and enaminamides as substrates.
